description: Election Commission - Declare that S. D. Peiris as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned council member, including the nomination procedure by the group leader and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. The content is primarily focused on electoral procedures and candidate selection at the local government level, making it a clear fit for the Elections category.
